title: Atlas prototype registry
description: The authoring source of truth for prototypes. CI mirrors these entries into the shared Supabase index; nothing writes back to this file.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Not part of the registry data.

prototypes.description: One entry per prototype on this branch.

id.description: Kebab-case slug. Must match the folder name in src/prototypes/ and becomes the URL: /prototypes/<id>.

name.description: Human-readable title shown on the hub card.

author.description: Who owns this prototype. Shown on the card so people know who to ask.

description.description: One line on what you are exploring. This is what teammates read before deciding to open it.
